blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A councilor from Taytay, Rizal has been ordered to explain why she should not face sanctions after a video showed her recording herself and dancing while driving. The Land Transportation Office (LTO) issued a show cause order (SCO) against the councilor over possible violations of the Anti-Distracted Driving Act, reckless driving regulations and the mandatory seat belt law. The video, which the councilor uploaded to her Facebook page, showed her taking one hand off the steering wheel to dance while the vehicle was moving.
